crypto_published_justification: Release signing uses maintained FLOSS Sigstore Cosign with ECDSA P-256 and SHA-256 and an ephemeral OIDC-bound certificate. Application cryptography is delegated to the maintained FLOSS Python TLS/OpenSSL, requests/urllib3 and standard hashing libraries; the application does not implement custom cryptographic primitives. Emporia authentication additionally calls pycognito SRP/HMAC-SHA256. No broken cryptographic primitive is used as an application default. See SECURITY and release-signatures for the signing scope. crypto_keylength_justification: The reviewed Python 3.12 client TLS context defaults to TLS 1.2 minimum, certificate/hostname validation and OpenSSL security level 2, with 128/256-bit symmetric ciphers. No application override weakens those defaults. Release signing uses ECDSA P-256 (128-bit security) with SHA-256. Emporia pycognito uses a 3072-bit SRP group and SHA-256. Operators must retain supported TLS configuration on the deployed host. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/dbus-emporia-vue/blob/main/SECURITY.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/dbus-emporia-vue/blob/main/emporia.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/dbus-emporia-vue/blob/main/docs/release-signatures.md

The documentation requires private operator configuration; password-verifier hashing for inbound users is not applicable. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/dbus-emporia-vue/blob/main/SECURITY.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/dbus-emporia-vue/blob/main/README.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/dbus-emporia-vue/blob/main/docs/configuration.md
crypto_random_justification: Cosign generates ephemeral signing keys using its cryptographically secure library RNG; keys are not retained in repository secrets or releases. The project delegates TLS cryptographic randomness to the platform cryptographic libraries. Emporia pycognito generates SRP randomness with os.urandom, and its retry jitter uses secrets; no insecure PRNG is used to create a project key or nonce. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/dbus-emporia-vue/blob/main/SECURITY.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/dbus-emporia-vue/blob/main/emporia.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/dbus-emporia-vue/blob/main/docs/release-signatures.md
